title: Metabolomics for Measuring Polyamine Levels in Mice Plasma, Brain, and Liver
author: Aisha Sati
materials: Collect the data with Xcalibur software (Thermo Scientific) and analyze by the integration of peak areas.

steps.title: Prepare Samples
steps.instruction: Dilute plasma (PND14 and 10 weeks), brain (PND14, 10 weeks and 18 months), and liver (PND14) samples in 80% methanol for the detection of ornithine, putrescine, spermidine, spermine, N1-acetylated spermine, and N1/8-acetylated spermidine.

steps.title: Configure LC-MS System
steps.instruction: Set up the liquid chromatography-mass spectrometry (LC-MS) system using a Poroshell 120 HILIC-Z PEEK column (Agilent InfinityLab), Dionex UltiMate 3000 LC System (Thermo Scientific), and Q Exactive Orbitrap mass spectrometer (Thermo Scientific) operated in positive mode.

steps.title: Perform Liquid Chromatography
steps.instruction: Run a linear gradient using acetonitrile (solvent A) and 10 millimolar (mM) ammonium formate (pH 3.8, solvent B) at a constant temperature of 25 °C.
